No first purchase

Sign-ups don’t pay for anything

A parent can watch the free class, love it and leave. Most aren’t ready for $5,000 yet, and with nothing smaller to buy, they buy nothing.

No ads

The class only fills when you post

Every registration depends on organic reach. A busy week at the rink means a quiet week for sign-ups, and there is no way to turn spend into booked calls.

No filter

Curious and committed look the same

A free sign-up tells you someone is curious. A purchase tells you they will invest in their athlete. Without that signal, you can’t tell who to follow up with personally.

The parents who would happily pay $27 today, and the few ready for $5,000, currently get exactly the same thing: a free video.

Script 1 · “The car ride home”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“The most important part of the game might be the drive home.”

Body

“After a tough game, a lot of parents want to fix it straight away. The athlete wants quiet. In 17 seasons inside pro sport, I’ve learned that what you say in those first ten minutes can shape how they walk into the next game. There’s a better way to handle that drive, and it’s simple.”

CTA

“It’s one of the five lessons in my Trust Your Game Kit. It’s $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera in the car or at the rink, on-screen text “the drive home” highlighted in gold.

Script 2 · “Practice vs game”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Why do some athletes look completely different in games than in practice?”

Body

“In practice, nothing’s on the line, so they play. In games, they start thinking about every touch, and thinking slows them down. The fix usually isn’t more skill work. It’s a routine that gets them out of their head and back into the play.”

CTA

“I’ll show you the routine in my Trust Your Game Kit. $27, instant access. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a slide with the 3 routine steps.

Script 3 · “17 seasons”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“I’ve spent 17 seasons inside pro sport. Here’s what the best athletes do in pressure moments.”

Body

“They still feel it. The nerves don’t go away. The difference is they have a way back to the next play: a breath, a cue word, a plan. That’s a skill, and young athletes can start building it now.”

CTA

“My Trust Your Game Kit walks you through it for $27. Tap Learn more below.”

Shot: talking to camera, lower third “NHL · OHL · PWHL”.
